statements.impact_statement: GO-2026-5932 covers the golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp packages (openpgp, packet, armor, clearsign, errors, elgamal, s2k); it has no fixed version because the packages are deprecated. No vmafx binary compiles them: `go list -deps ./...` names no openpgp package (the x/crypto packages in the build are argon2, blake2b, md4 and sha3), `go mod why golang.org/x/crypto/openpgp` answers that the main module does not need the package, and govulncheck v1.8.0 at symbol level reports the advisory only at module level. scripts/ci/govulncheck-gate.py fails as soon as a package or symbol of the advisory becomes reachable without a new statement.
